question_patterns: 年輪可以拿來算年紀嗎
為什麼鋸開的樹幹有很多圈
first_sentence: 樹幹有圈圈，是因為每年都長出一圈。
facts: 每一圈大約代表樹長大了一年
春天和夏天長得快，顏色比較淺
秋天和冬天長得慢，顏色比較深
ask_back: 你猜年輪能告訴我們樹的什麼？

bridges.has_garden: 你家院子的樹，你猜它今年幾歲？

question_patterns: why does a tree have rings
why are there circles in a tree trunk
what do tree rings tell us
en.first_sentence: Tree trunks have rings because the tree adds one each year.
facts: Each ring shows about one year of the tree growing.
Spring and summer rings are light, because the tree grows fast.
Fall and winter rings are dark, because the tree grows slowly.
en.ask_back: Do you think a tree with more rings is older, or younger?

bridges.has_garden: Have you seen a tree stump in a garden with rings on it?
